_about: English descriptions for every channel, merged into the generated database by
tools/build_database.py as 'description_en'. The German text from the FR and the
DAMOS is kept alongside as 'description' -- this file never replaces it.
Every line here is a translation of that German, not an interpretation of what the
variable does. Where the source is itself cryptic the translation stays cryptic;
nothing has been inferred from the name, the address or the conversion. Bosch
abbreviations are expanded on first use within a line.
Abbreviations used throughout the M3.8 framework:
LR / LRHK  lambda control / lambda control behind the catalyst
VK / HK    vor Kat / hinter Kat -- pre-catalyst / post-catalyst
TE         Einspritzzeit, injection time
TEV        Tankentlueftungsventil, evaporative purge valve
LL / LLR   Leerlauf / Leerlaufregelung -- idle / idle speed control
LLS        Leerlaufsteller, idle air actuator
DVL        the idle actuator's position loop (ESB motor plus feedback pot)
KR         Klopfregelung, knock control; SPV = Spaetverstellung, retard
ZW         Zuendwinkel, ignition angle
DK         Drosselklappe, throttle plate
LDR        Ladedruckregelung, boost pressure control; TV = duty cycle
AGR        Abgasrueckfuehrung, exhaust gas recirculation
SLS        Sekundaerluftsystem, secondary air system
ASE        Aussetzererkennung, misfire detection; LU = Laufunruhe, roughness
UK         Uebergangskompensation, transient (wall-film) compensation
DLDP       the tank leak diagnosis pump
TRA / FRA  additive / multiplicative lambda adaptation
A name ending '+1' points at the second byte of a 16-bit word. Where the plain
name is also present it holds the whole word and the '+1' entry is just its high
byte; where it is not, the '+1' entry is the value itself.
